title: MagLava
subtitle: Swing higher. Outrun the lava.
shortDescription: Tether, swing and climb through 40 stages above the rising lava.
fullDescription:
Rise or burn.

Climb an industrial shaft by throwing magnetic tethers at color-matched nodes while lava rises below. Tap a color, catch a node and carry your swing into the next launch. Retarget in midair, find your rhythm and reach the summit.

40 HANDCRAFTED STAGES
Follow a campaign of winding climbs, branching routes and fast sprints. Cross checkpoints to secure your progress, then take on spinning sweepers, pulse rings, laser gates, roaming hazards and magnetic fields. Special stages challenge you to climb through darkness, race a rival or keep your bearings as the shaft rolls.

BUILT FOR A RESPONSIVE CLIMB
Native 3D graphics, glowing hazards and interpolated movement keep the action readable. Large color controls, matching letter badges and target outlines help you plan each launch. The complete original soundtrack plays continuously across menus and stages. Music, sound effects and haptic feedback are optional, and reduced motion keeps the camera steady.

CHASE YOUR BEST
Earn stars for finishing, beating par or clearing a stage without a death. Personal best times, scores and stage progress are saved on your device. Pause when you need a break and retry quickly from a checkpoint.

Play offline. No ads, purchases or account required.
whatsNew: A brighter 3D ascent: glossy magnetic orbs, glowing ghosts, richer lava and an animated home screen. The complete original soundtrack now plays continuously across menus and stages and loops through all four songs. New hit shockwaves, fragments and sparks make every impact clearer. Matching triangular controls and reduced-motion options on both mobile platforms.
